research_name: Trading competition winners (Robbins World Cup, US Investing Championship) with disclosed rules
topic: transparent replicable intraday edges for cheap bot-allowed 5K/10K prop accounts (FundedNext Stellar Instant)
result_summary: No competition winner with a full, testable intraday rulebook was found. The best partial disclosure is a 2023 US Investing Championship top-4 trader summarized by Financial Wisdom TV; its rules are vague and swing-based, not intraday. Other winners have only secondhand or non-testable descriptions.

entry_rule: Classic Breakout: alert set at consolidation trendline; trigger type (touch, close, or volume) not stated [uncertain]. event_overlap: Gap-on-catalyst setup overlaps with earnings and news events; timing not quantified.
